name: Suitcase Carry March
instructions: Hold a heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side.
March in place or walk, lifting the knees.
longevityNotes: Carrying is the most functional strength there is — groceries, luggage, a grandchild. Loaded carries build grip, posture, and core stability in one movement.
overview: A single-side loaded carry with a march that trains the obliques and hip stability.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
safetyNotes: Use a weight you can carry upright.
